meta.title: Overview | Invessiv
meta.description: Your project status, open items and your contact at a glance.

mock.dialogIntro: This area is still being prepared. Once it is live, you will find here:

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.submitted: Submitted on {date}. We’re reviewing your answers.

booking.text: We’ve reviewed your answers. In the onboarding call we go through them together. Pick a time with {name}.
booking.noticeNamed: The calendar runs on {provider}. It opens in a new tab; only then does {provider} receive data from you.
booking.noticeOther: The calendar runs on an external scheduling provider. It opens in a new tab; only then does the provider receive data from you.

fallback.text: We’ve reviewed your answers and will get in touch with you to arrange a time.

project.title: Your project
project.pausedNote: This project is paused right now. We will get in touch before it continues.
project.plannedNote: This project starts soon. You will see its progress here once we begin.
project.emptyDescription: Once we start, you will see the progress, the next step and what we need from you here. If you have questions, your contact is always there for you.

customerTasks.title: Needed from you
customerTasks.dialogDescription: We need these items from you to keep things moving. Tick off what is done – we see it right away. You can undo a tick you set yourself.
customerTasks.empty: All done. We don't need anything from you right now.
customerTasks.ownerHint: Nothing can be ticked off in the portal view.

ourTasks.title: What we're working on
ourTasks.empty: Nothing visible is on our list for this project right now. We will be in touch as soon as things move on.
ourTasks.ownerHint: No task can be created in the portal view.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.emptyTitle: This is where you give us feedback
feedback.emptyDescription: As soon as we show you a version, you tell us here point by point what works and what we should change.

hours.title: Hour budget
hours.teaser: Soon you will see here how many hours of your budget are used and how many are left.
upcoming: Every booking with date and description

booking.noticeNamed: The calendar is hosted by {provider}. It opens in a new tab; the provider only receives your data then.
booking.noticeOther: The calendar is hosted by an external provider. It opens in a new tab; the provider only receives your data then.

messages.title: Messages
messages.teaser: Soon you can write to us right here – no long email threads.

files.title: Files
files.emptyFromUs: As soon as we share something with you, it appears here.
files.emptyFromYou: Upload logos, photos or copy for your project under “All files”.
files.previewUnavailable: The preview could not be loaded. Open “All files” to try again there.

serviceRequest.title: Request a service
serviceRequest.teaser: Soon you can request additional services right here – for example a new page module.
upcoming: Our services with a short description
A request in just a few clicks

announce.failed: “{name}” could not be saved. Please try again.
announce.requested: “{name}” has reached us. You will find the task under “What we're working on”.

request.title: Create a task for us
request.description: Tell us what to do for “{project}”. The task then appears under “What we're working on”.
request.descriptionNoProject: Tell us what to do for your project. The task then appears under “What we're working on”.
request.titlePlaceholder: e.g. add opening hours to the footer
request.titleRequired: Briefly describe what we should do.
request.detailsHint: Optional: copy, links or anything that makes the work easier for us.
request.dueHint: Optional. We will let you know if we cannot make it by then.
request.duePast: The preferred date is in the past.

errors.not_found: This project is no longer available. Reload the page and try again.
errors.validation: We could not save this. Please check your entries.
errors.no_assignee: We cannot assign the task to anyone right now. Please message us in the chat.
errors.limit_reached: You already have many open tasks for this project. Once we have finished some, you can create new ones.
errors.unavailable: That did not work just now. Please try again.

chat.title: Messages
chat.readAlong: You write directly to us here. Everyone on your team with portal access reads along.
chat.body: The chat is being prepared. Until then, you can reach us by email.
